reason: The frozen protocol names constraint regimes and stochastic explorers but does not fully specify their outcome-generating constructions. This amendment removes that residual analyst discretion before any confirmatory outcome is computed.

permitted_information: published CRABS source code and documentation
existing pilot implementation solely to identify previously declared comparator defaults

environment_qualification.r_library: isolated task-local library with CRABS installed from the frozen source commit
environment_qualification.failure_rule: No CRABS or primates cell is eligible unless commit, version, package loading, and source hashes pass exactly.

primates_qualification.reference_model: piecewise-linear lambda and mu functions with constant endpoint extension, passed to CRABS::create.model on the native time grid
primates_qualification.resampling: piecewise-linear interpolation from the qualified native grid onto equally spaced grids of 25, 100, and 400 knots over the unchanged native domain
primates_qualification.redistribution_rule: Any public package containing the extracted or derived primates table must retain GPL-3 component attribution and licence notices; qualification does not itself authorize redistribution.

deterministic_constraint_construction.none: Evaluate no_external_point_bounds only; no external interval constraints are supplied.
deterministic_constraint_construction.constraint_locations: The nearest evaluation-grid knots to domain fractions 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1, with duplicates removed while preserving order.

feasible_intervals.witness_turnover: On successive x intervals use turnover_cap multiplied by the cyclic fractions [0.2, 0.6, 0.4, 0.8].
feasible_intervals.band_half_width: 0.02 times max(1, x_last-1). At non-anchor constraint knots, lower_n=max(1-rho, n_witness-half_width) and upper_n=n_witness+half_width.

known_infeasible.forced_witness: At the final constraint knot set lower_n to upper_n at the preceding constraint knot plus turnover_cap times their x separation plus margin; set upper_n=lower_n.
known_infeasible.expected_status: infeasible by a finite directed-Lipschitz certificate; a positive-survival barrier may additionally be present

deterministic_constraint_construction.comparison: Production float64 outputs are compared with the independent 80-digit Decimal oracle under the frozen endpoint tolerance, including matching signed infinity.

crabs_reference_construction.reference_lambda: piecewise-linear interpolation of lambda_p with constant endpoint extension
crabs_reference_construction.lambda0: lambda_p at the first time knot
crabs_reference_construction.equal_grid_check: max absolute deviation of interval widths from the first width must not exceed 1e-12 times max(1, absolute first width)

rng.seed_rule: Use the registered cell seed exactly once at cell start; never replace or offset it.

crabs_hsmrf.acceptance: Every finite proposal with strictly positive lambda is retained; this is the native unconstrained task, so no turnover-cap rejection is applied.

crabs_gmrf.acceptance: Every finite proposal with strictly positive lambda is retained; this is the native unconstrained task, so no turnover-cap rejection is applied.

crabs_rejection.acceptance: Retain only finite proposals with lambda>0, mu>=-1e-12, and max(mu/lambda)<=turnover_cap+1e-12.

cap_aware_uniform.draw: Independently draw one turnover value per time knot from Uniform(0, turnover_cap).
cap_aware_uniform.construction: Use the registered equal-grid CRABS joint recurrence with lambda[1]=lambda0; invalid discriminants or nonpositive rates are retained as failed proposals.

boundary_constructor.construction: Construct exactly two positive-control paths using constant turnover zero and constant turnover equal to the registered cap in the same CRABS recurrence.
boundary_constructor.accepted_cloud_prefixes: not applicable to this deterministic positive control
boundary_constructor.success: Both endpoint deficits are at most the frozen 1e-10 normalized tolerance and recurrence residuals pass.

persistence_and_censoring.cell_result: One canonical JSON result per registered cell, written atomically and never overwritten with different bytes.
persistence_and_censoring.resumption: A cell is skipped only when its existing result validates against the cell id, protocol hash, amendment hash, and implementation commit.
persistence_and_censoring.retained_samples: For stochastic cells retain exact proposal/accept/rejection counts, cloud minima and maxima at every knot for each attained prefix, and accepted lambda values at the four registered decision ages. Registered seeds permit regeneration of full paths.
persistence_and_censoring.failures: Sampler exceptions, nonfinite proposals, invalid recurrences, and proposal-ceiling censoring remain in the ledger. No seed replacement or rescue run is permitted.
persistence_and_censoring.wall_clock: No unregistered per-cell wall-clock censor is introduced. Interruption of the overall job creates no outcome decision; the same cells resume from their deterministic seeds.

interpretation_boundary: This amendment makes the protocol executable. It supplies no evidence for any hypothesis and authorizes neither publication nor outreach.
